en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town square with a prominent church tower featuring a clock and onion-shaped spire. To the right, partially visible behind trees, is a castle-like building with round towers. At street level there are a few pedestrians and cyclists, and a shopfront on the left. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the church and castle in Nossen, Saxony.
